steps.why: reference / hold / watch / conditional labels are not calls a viewer can act on
e.g. 'buy' with bearish/neutral sentiment: the two LLM fields contradict each other
ETFs, funds, crypto, commodities and indices are not stock picks (an S&P 500 ETF has zero excess return over SPY by construction)
exchange-suffixed tickers (.DE, .L, .PA ...) are quoted in other currencies; comparing them with SPY would mix in FX moves
ticker does not resolve at Yahoo, Tiingo or the old price table - mostly garbled or invented symbols (NVIDIA, FORTNET, PALO ...)
channels with fewer than 50 analysed videos (added in a March 2026 test, or missing channel metadata) say nothing about the channel
two videos by the same channel on the same day repeating the same call
no close within 5 days after the video: not listed yet, already delisted, or the ticker belongs to a different company at that time
penny-stock quotes below $1 (bankrupt shells, OTC leftovers) move in ticks of hundreds of percent and would dominate every average
price series breaks off inside the first window
